blurb: Middle Tennessee Hot Air Adventures is a family business nestled in the quiet town of Franklin, TN, just south of Nashville. We offer hot air ballooning services in Nashville & Franklin Tennessee as well as all surrounding areas. We pride ourselves in ballooning over less developed areas, lofting over hollows and hidden lakes, offering breath taking views of wildlife and the rolling hills of Middle Tennessee. Join
